haiku.sentence: On Haiku 5.5, on 16 vignettes, the model's predictions of its own-answer pull were more accurate under the self label than under the Sam label: self minus Sam error -0.185, 95% BCa interval [-0.282, -0.087], wholly below 0. Both labels read the same transcript; they differ only in the subject named. 'Self' is the model in a fresh context reading the transcript, not the model in its own conversation.
